float_sum.command:
docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -v '/home/ubuntu/armA-amd64/work':'/home/ubuntu/armA-amd64/work' -w '/home/ubuntu/armA-amd64/work' 'crossarch1166:pin' sh -c 'if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bash -c "$1"; else exec sh -c "$1"; fi' sh 'python3 -c "print('\''%.17g'\'' % sum(1.0/i for i in range(1, 1001)))" > float.txt
# Many FP values in one file: magnifies any per-operation rounding drift.
python3 -c "
vals = [1.0/i for i in range(1, 2001)]
import math
print('\''%.17g'\'' % math.fsum(vals))
print('\''%.17g'\'' % sum(vals))
print('\''%.17g'\'' % (sum(vals) - math.fsum(vals)))
" > float_series.txt
'

prepare.command:
docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -v '/home/ubuntu/armA-amd64/work':'/home/ubuntu/armA-amd64/work' -w '/home/ubuntu/armA-amd64/work' 'crossarch1166:pin' sh -c 'if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bash -c "$1"; else exec sh -c "$1"; fi' sh 'mkdir -p '\''data'\''
mkdir -p data
: > data/payload.txt
for i in $(seq 1 64); do echo "line $i value $((i * 37 % 97))" >> data/payload.txt; done
# Fixed byte pattern (no /dev/urandom): exercises raw binary output.
python3 -c "import sys; sys.stdout.buffer.write(bytes((i*53+7) % 256 for i in range(4096)))" > data/bytes.bin
'

text_and_compress.command:
docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -v '/home/ubuntu/armA-amd64/work':'/home/ubuntu/armA-amd64/work' -w '/home/ubuntu/armA-amd64/work' 'crossarch1166:pin' sh -c 'if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bash -c "$1"; else exec sh -c "$1"; fi' sh 'mkdir -p '\''data'\''
{ sort data/payload.txt | wc -l ; sort -u data/payload.txt | head -3 ; } > summary.txt
gzip -n -c data/payload.txt > data/payload.txt.gz
gzip -n -c data/bytes.bin > data/bytes.bin.gz
sha256sum data/payload.txt data/bytes.bin > manifest.sha256
'
